question: From which knot are the three principles said to be situated?
premises: Their location is described as situated from a knot
The knot is named the brahma-granthi
inference: The three are indeed situated from the brahma-granthi, O beautiful-faced one
uncertainties: The referent of etāṃ/trīṇi is syntactically compressed
plain_english: Situated from the brahma-granthi, these are indeed the three, O beautiful-faced one.
